Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin maturity-schedules skill with the generalizable pitfall:

- For older 1940s/early-1950s maturity schedules, “fixed maturity type” means use the fixed maturity / total fixed maturity issues row, not the grand total for all marketable securities.
- For repeated “as of last day of January” questions, build a time series from the same Jan. 31 snapshot in each calendar year, then run OLS and round only the final projection.

Also updated durable memory with the compact reminder: maturity fixed row ≠ grand total.
